description: Measure 148L catalytic geometry and summarise GH24 cleft occupancy in Asp-less endolysins
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.makedirs("struct",exist_ok=True)
if not os.path.exists("struct/148L.pdb"):
    open("struct/148L.pdb","wb").write(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/148L.pdb",timeout=120).content)
def parse_pdb(p):
    rows=[]
    for l in open(p):
        if l.startswith(("ATOM  ","HETATM")):
            rows.append((l[:6].strip(),l[12:16].strip(),l[16],l[17:20].strip(),l[21],int(l[22:26]),
                         float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["rec","name","alt","resn","ch","resi","x","y","z"])
A=parse_pdb("struct/148L.pdb"); A=A[A.alt.isin([' ','A'])]
P=A[(A.ch=='E')&(A.rec=='ATOM')]
C1=A[(A.resn=='MUB')&(A.name=='C1')][["x","y","z"]].to_numpy()[0]
O4=A[(A.resn=='MUB')&(A.name=='O4')][["x","y","z"]].to_numpy()[0]   # glycosidic O to NAG
def at(resi,name):
    s=P[(P.resi==resi)&(P.name==name)]
    return s[["x","y","z"]].to_numpy()[0] if len(s) else None
d=lambda a,b: float(np.linalg.norm(a-b))

polar={11:['OE1','OE2'],20:['OD1','OD2'],22:['OE1','OE2'],26:['OE1','OE2'],
       35:['NZ'],70:['OD1','OD2'],105:['OE1','NE2'],142:['OG1'],145:['NH1','NH2','NE'],31:['ND1','NE2']}
rec=[]
for resi,names in polar.items():
    rn=P[P.resi==resi].resn.iloc[0]
    for nm in names:
        a=at(resi,nm)
        if a is None: continue
        rec.append(dict(residue=f"{rn}{resi}",atom=nm,d_to_C1=round(d(a,C1),2),d_to_O4glyc=round(d(a,O4),2)))
G=pd.DataFrame(rec).sort_values("d_to_C1")
print("148L: polar/charged cleft atoms vs the scissile centre (MurNAc C1) and glycosidic O4\n")
print(G.to_string(index=False))
G.to_csv("148L_catalytic_geometry.csv",index=False)

# Asp20 vs Glu22 carboxylate separation (same beta-strand, i / i+2)
p20=[at(20,'OD1'),at(20,'OD2'),at(20,'CG')]; p22=[at(22,'OE1'),at(22,'OE2'),at(22,'CD')]
print(f"\nAsp20 CG to Glu22 CD distance: {d(p20[2],p22[2]):.2f} A")
print(f"min carboxylate-O distance Asp20 to Glu22: {min(d(a,b) for a in p20[:2] for b in p22[:2]):.2f} A")
print(f"Asp20 CA to Glu22 CA: {d(at(20,'CA'),at(22,'CA')):.2f} A")
# are 20 and 22 on the same face? angle between CA->CB vectors
v20=at(20,'CB')-at(20,'CA'); v22=at(22,'CB')-at(22,'CA')
cosang=float(np.dot(v20,v22)/np.linalg.norm(v20)/np.linalg.norm(v22))
print(f"cos(angle) between CA-CB vectors of residues 20 and 22: {cosang:.2f} (1 = same side of strand)")
print(f"Glu11 OE1 to Asp20 OD2: {d(at(11,'OE1'),at(20,'OD2')):.2f} A")
print(f"Glu11 OE1 to Glu22 OE1: {d(at(11,'OE1'),at(22,'OE1')):.2f} A")
print(f"Glu11 OE1 to Thr/Glu26 OE2: {d(at(11,'OE1'),at(26,'OE2')):.2f} A")

# ---------------- FIGURE ----------------
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,9))
ax=fig.add_subplot(2,2,1)
sub=G.groupby("residue").d_to_C1.min().sort_values()
colors=['#c0392b' if r in ('GLU11',) else '#e67e22' if r=='ASP20' else '#2c7fb8' if r=='GLU26' else '#95a5a6' for r in sub.index]
ax.barh(range(len(sub)),sub.values,color=colors)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(sub)));ax.set_yticklabels(sub.index,fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(4.5,ls='--',c='k',lw=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel("closest polar side-chain atom to MurNAc C1 (angstrom)")
ax.set_title("A. T4 lysozyme active site, PDB 148L\n(covalent intermediate at engineered Glu26)",fontsize=10)
ax.invert_yaxis()

ax=fig.add_subplot(2,2,2); ax.axis('off')
labels=["T4 phage T4L","Dicty LysT1","T4 gp5 needle","P22 gp19","phage T1","phage Mu","phage P1",
        "phi29 gp15","PZA gp15","B103 gp15","L. phage c2","L. phage vML3"]
vals=[["E11","D20","T26"],["E13","D22","T28"],["E184","D193","T199"],["E16","D25","T31"],
      ["E27","D36","T42"],["E37","D46","T52"],["E42","C51","T57"],
      ["E15","P26","T32"],["E15","P26","T32"],["E15","P26","T32"],["E15","P24","T32"],["E15","P24","T32"]]
ax.set_title("B. Residues at the three T4L catalytic positions",fontsize=10,loc='left')
for k,(lab,v) in enumerate(zip(labels,vals)):
    y=1-0.075*(k+1.4)
    ax.text(0.0,y,lab,fontsize=9,va='center')
    for c,(col,x) in enumerate(zip(v,[0.45,0.62,0.79])):
        bad = (c==1 and col[0] not in "DE")
        ax.text(x,y,col,fontsize=9,va='center',ha='center',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25',fc='#f1948a' if bad else '#aed6f1',ec='none'))
for x,t in zip([0.45,0.62,0.79],["Glu11\ngeneral acid","Asp20\nalpha-side","Thr26\nalpha-side"]):
    ax.text(x,0.95,t,fontsize=9,ha='center',va='center',fontweight='bold')

ax=fig.add_subplot(2,1,2); ax.axis('off')
cl=[11,20,21,22,24,26,30,31,32,35,70,104,105,106,107,142,145]
dsug={11:2.80,20:2.92,21:3.92,22:3.60,24:3.53,26:1.51,30:2.93,31:3.85,32:2.84,35:4.06,70:3.54,
      104:2.67,105:2.69,106:3.68,107:3.51,142:3.81,145:3.88}
t4res={11:'E',20:'D',21:'T',22:'E',24:'Y',26:'T',30:'G',31:'H',32:'L',35:'K',70:'D',
       104:'F',105:'Q',106:'M',107:'G',142:'T',145:'R'}
gp15={11:'E15',20:'P26',21:'T27',22:'E28',24:'H30',26:'T32',30:'G36',31:'H37',32:'Y38',35:'D41',70:'D60',
      104:'Y89',105:'N90',106:'V91',107:'G92',142:'L131',145:'R134'}
c2  ={11:'E15',20:'P24',21:'V25',22:'E28',24:'M30',26:'T32',30:'G36',31:'H37',32:'Y38',35:'A42',70:'E79',
      104:'P112',105:'K113',106:'Y114',107:'R115',142:'T150',145:'M153'}
ax.set_title("C. T4L substrate-binding cleft positions (<= 4.5 angstrom from bound MurNAc-GlcNAc in 148L)\nmapped onto Asp-less GH24 endolysins",fontsize=10,loc='left')
for i,p in enumerate(cl):
    x=0.03+i*0.057
    ax.text(x,0.72,f"{t4res[p]}{p}",ha='center',fontsize=9,fontweight='bold')
    ax.text(x,0.62,f"{dsug[p]:.1f}",ha='center',fontsize=7,color='#555555')
    for y,dd,nm in [(0.42,gp15,'phi29 gp15'),(0.22,c2,'L. phage c2 lysin')]:
        v=dd[p]; ac=v[0] in "DE"
        ax.text(x,y,v,ha='center',fontsize=8,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2',fc='#f1948a' if (p==20) else ('#a9dfbf' if ac else '#ecf0f1'),ec='none'))
ax.text(0.01,0.80,"T4L",fontsize=9,fontweight='bold')
ax.text(0.01,0.62,"d(sugar), A",fontsize=7,color='#555555')
ax.text(0.01,0.50,"phi29 gp15",fontsize=9,fontweight='bold')
ax.text(0.01,0.30,"c2 lysin",fontsize=9,fontweight='bold')
ax.text(0.01,0.06,"green = acidic residue retained at that cleft position; red = the lost Asp20 position, occupied by proline",fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
